tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde mchog nag po lugs kyi gzhi bsnyen byed tshul grub pa'i gsang gtam bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī he ru kā ya/ 'khor lo bde mchog nag po lugs kyi gzhi bsnyen byed tshul go bde'i ngag gis brjod na/ 'di'i dbang lung khrid sogs thob pa'i gang zag gis mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i gnas su 'grigs na rang nyid kha lhor phyogs pa'i mal dang / de min khang pa'i babs dang bstun mal bcas pa'i mdun nam g.yas phyogs su bde mchog bris 'bur gang rung gi rten dang / chos skyong gi bris sku sogs bkram pa'i drung stegs bang rim can la bdud rtsi ril bu dang sbyar ba'i gtor ma zlum po lnga'am gsum sogs 'og tu gtor bsngo gang byed dang babs bstun gyi gtor ma chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang bcas pa dang / thun gzhan la kha gso ba'i mtheb skyu bcas dang rang gi mal drung lcogs steng rdor dril ḍā ma ru nang mchod 'thor nas bcas bsham/ phreng ba mi thod mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'am/ de min bodhi'i 'phreng ba gshin po dang tha mal pas longs spyad pa sogs ma yin pa'am yang na bo dhi tsit+ta brgya dang bcu gcig chu grang gro chang bdud rtsi ril bu'i khu ba rnams kyis bkrus/ bla ma'am rang gang rung gi sngags gul gyis bdug gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i srad bu dgu sgril dmar po'am mdog gang yang rung ba la hūm̐ bzhi pa'i sngags dang gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po bzla zhing brgyus brgya stong khri 'bum gyi grangs 'dzin bcu shad mdo 'dzin nyis brtsegs bcas shin tu gtsang sbra dang ldan zhing gzhan lag ma brgyud pa dang gzhan yang zla ba drug sogs ji tsam byed pa la 'dod pa'i mthun rkyen rnams tshang zhing dkor dang grib kyi rigs la 'dzem cha dang / sman pa mtshams g.yog rnams kyang gnyis gsum sogs thog ma nas lhus things dmigs 'og tu bcug 'og dal bar grims/ mjug je lhod/ kha lag mi bkru/ skra mi 'breg

mal drod ma yal ba/ gnas khang la byi dor mi byed/ skyid sdug legs nyes ci 'dra byung song yang thog mar dam bcas pa de las mi 'da' snyam pa'i snying khams bskyed de dngos nyams rmi lam sogs la bzang zhing legs pa byung yang ched 'dzin mi byed ngan zhing sdug pa byung yang rnam rtog gi dbang du mi gtong bar thugs dam gang byed de la sems sgrims nas byed dgos pas mngon rtogs kyang bshar sbyangs tsam ma yin par tshig rjes su sems phri li li 'gro ba zhig bsgom/ rlung sbyor shes na rdzogs rim gyi skabs su bum can ci nus 'dzin/ bzlas pa'i skabs su phar 'khor gyi dmigs pa sogs sa lo'i sgrub thabs su gsungs pa bzhin dang / de kho nas ma 'khyol ba lta bu byung na bskyed rim rnam bshad rnams nas gsungs pa bzhin rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la sems 'dzin cing bzla ba dang / skabs 'gar sngags kyi sgra grag stong la sems gtad nas bzla ba dang / skabs 'gar 'das pa'i rjes mi gcod ma 'ongs pa'i 'dun mi bsu/ da lta'i shes pa la bzo bcos mi bya bar had de phyad de'i ngang nas bzla ba sogs/ mdor na sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig tu sgril nas bzlas pas/ thog mar lus la nad dang sems la rnam rtog sogs sngar ye med pa rnams kyang bun gyis langs mod yang / de dag gi dbang du ma btang bar dge sbyor la rtag 'grus dang / sman dang zas spyod sogs bying rgod sel ba'i thabs spyi 'gre nyams su blangs pas rim gyis dge mtshan rnams 'byung bas na de dag nges par byas nas/ mtshams la 'jug pa'i sngon du brgyad tog sogs mdo rnams ci nus bklag sāts+tshā dang gtor ma 'grub tshad bya/ zla ba gang rung gi yar ngo'i tshes bcu'am/ mar ngo'i nyer lnga sogs la thog mar sgrub khang du cha gsum gtor ma yid ches pa gsum la sogs pa btags/ bgegs gtor phyir dor ba'i tshe lus kyi rdo dril gsor dkrol dang thun yungs kyis sgrub khang la brab cing sngags gul bdug

ngag tu drag sngags shes tshad bzla/ sems kyis sgo mtshams ma brgyad sogs khro mo dang khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa dpag tu med pas sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad phyi rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu bskrad par bsam/ sgrub khang gi phyir/ tho dkar po mngon mtshan can btsugs/ 'di la rgyas par na rgyal chen bskyed chog sogs dang / 'bring po la bgegs skrod mnga' gsol shis brjod mdzad pa cig 'dug kyang / bsdu na btsugs pa rang gis go chod de nang du log mal la 'khod nas thog mar bde mchog brgyud 'debs dang / rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku bstod gang shes bton/ thun gsum pa'am thun bzhi ma gang rung gsungs kyang / las dang po pa la thun bzhi ma bde bas/ 'dir gong thun la dbu btsugs pa'i dbang du btang nas/ thog mar gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ de nas skyabs yul gsal 'debs nas bzung go cha gsum gyis bsrungs la lus dkyil yig 'brur bsgyur ba'i bar bya/ de nas gtor bsngo rgyas bsdus gang rung / tshogs 'khor bsdus pa bcas byas la/ mjug bsdus nas/ lung pa de'i ri la nyi ma ma byon tsam la grol/ yang sa srib nas nam phyed tsam bar sogs ci nus la srod thun blangs la skyabs 'gro nas bkra shis kyi bar kho bos brtsams pa'i sgrub thabs 'bring po bzhin byas la/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal/ dgong thun dang srod thun gyi grol mtshams 'di ni 'og gdong bzhi'i skabs dang stabs gcig tu bris pa yin zhing tshul nyin gyi thun gnyis po 'di la de tsam gyi yun mi thog thun 'di gnyis la skyabs 'gro yig brgya rnams nyer gcig re dang rtsa sngags gnyis med gsung / snying po gnyis med 'phreng 'khor nye snying gnyis med nas/ go cha gnyis med kyi bar gsum re/ zhal bzhi pa'i sngags/ sum+bha ni tshar gsum re bzla'o/ /sang tho rengs snga phyi ji tsam rigs par ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs la skyabs 'gro nas bkra shis kyi bar sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin dang gtor bsngo bsdus pa byas la lung par der nyi ma ma shar tsam la grol/

de nas gtor ma sogs thugs dam chags med gzhan yod na bar 'dir byas la nyi ma shar dros nas bzung phyed ma zin bar snga thun la sgrub thabs 'bring po dang gtor bsngo bsdus pa bya/ de nas dgong srod kyi thun gnyis ni sngar dang 'dra bar bya zhing / mtshams la zhugs pa'i sang de nas bzung zhag gcig gnyis sogs la thun gyi dngos gzhi skyabs 'gro kho na la grangs bzung / bzlas pa 'phreng 'khor kha re bsags/ de nas zhag grangs ci rigs la skyabs 'gro nyer gcig sogs ci nus dang thun dngos yig brgya la grangs bzung / 'di'i skabs su thun bzhi char la rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas sbyar/ de nas skyabs 'gro yig brgya rnams ji ltar 'os pa dang thun bzhi char la rtsa sngags gnyis med tshar gsum re/ snying po gnyis med brgya stong sogs ci 'grub thun gyi mthar/ nye snying gnyis med nas sgo mtshams ma gnyis med kyi bar gsum re/ go cha gnyis med dang zhal bzhi pa'i sngags bdun re bzla/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis snying po gnyis med la 'bum bzhi kha skong bcas song ba dang / thun rnams la gzhan gong 'dra la/ snying po gnyis med gsum tsam bzlas nas/ nye snying gnyis med la grangs bzung la chig 'bum mam bzhi 'bum gang rung bzla/ de song ba dang snying po'i rnal 'byor ma'i sngags la zhal bzhi pa spel ba'am spel med gang rung dang / 'khor lo gsum gyi sngags/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la rkang brgyad spel ba'am spel med gang rung so so nas bzhi khri re bzla/ cho ga gnyis med la bzhi 'bum kha skong bcas bzla dgos pas/ de dag la gnyis med kyi ngos 'dzin ni/ oṃ na mo nas/ dhi li dhi li'i bar dang / na mo bha ga wa te nas/ swāhā bar rtsa sngags gnyis med de yab kyi hūm̐ phaṭa dang yum kyi oṃ bzhag pa la zer/ snying po gnyis med ni oṃ shrī nas/ ḍā ki ni dza la sam+bha raṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye sogs/ nye snying gnyis med ni oṃ hrīḥha ha sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye sogs/

snying po rnal 'byor ma bzhi la zhal bzhi pa spel ba ni gsung rgyun bzhin dang / dpa' bo nyer bzhi dang dpa' mo nyer bzhi la rkang 'don du bzla ba dang gnyis med du bzla ba gnyis las/ sa lo'i gsung rab la gnyis med du bzla bar gsung ba bzhin stabs bde/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la rkang brgyad spel lugs gsung rgyun bzhin/ cho ga gnyis med ni go sla'o/ /yang sa lo'i gsung rab la/ rtsa sngags/ snying po/ nye snying gnyis med rnams la'ang hūm̐ phaṭa dang / oṃ ma bzhag par bzlas kyang gnyis med du 'gro bar gsungs pas rang gang bde bya'o/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyis grangs 'dzin tshul ni gong du bshad pa ltar/ snying po nye snying / lha re re'i sngags kyi grangs rdzogs pa na de nyung zhing rjes ma rnams rim bzhin grangs gsog byed pa ni rim gyis pa'i lugs dang / cig car ba'i lugs la thun re la snying po nye snying go cha rnams stong bzlas na gzhan rnams brgya re bzlas pas gtso 'khor thams cad kyi grangs gcig la 'gro ba zhig 'byung yang las dang po pa rnams kyis 'di shin tu dka' bas snga ma kho na legs so/ /de nas mtshams nang de nyid du sbyin sreg bya'am/ gnas gzhan du'ang rung / kha skong sbyin sreg byed tshul ni zur gsal bzhin dang / de skabs su thor thun dang snga thun gnyis sbyin sreg gis go bcad/ srod thun ma chag tsam re byas nas mtshams grol ba'am/ yang na mtshams yongs rdzogs grub nas sbyin sreg byas kyang 'gal ba med do/ /gang ltar na'ang mtshams grol ba'i tshe hab thob tu mi grol gsungs pas mi rnams je mang je mang la 'phrad nas rim gyis grol na legs pa yin no/ /zhes 'khor lo bde mchog nag po lugs kyi gzhi bsnyen 'bring po byed tshul nyung ngu 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis sbyar zhing 'di'i dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba drug tsam yin par gsungs kyang / mtshan ma dang grangs kho na gtso che bas lo mtshams lta bur thogs kyang 'gal ba med par sems so/

/zhes lha chen rab 'byams pa rgyal mtshan yar 'phel gyi re skong du bris pa'i yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa bsod nams 'od zer gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ bde mchog nag po lugs kyi gzhi bsnyen byed tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
